channel.title: +०४-सीता-पीडनम् on रामायणे विश्वासटिप्पन्यः
channel.description: Recent content in +०४-सीता-पीडनम् on रामायणे विश्वासटिप्पन्यः

item.title: ०१८ अशोकवाटिकायां रावणागमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Hanuma sees Ravana entering Ashoka garden with a retinue of his wives following him.

भागसूचना
  1. अपनी स्त्रियोंसे घिरे हुए रावणका अशोकवाटिकामें आगमन और हनुमान् जी का उसे देखना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

As only a fraction of the night remains and Vedic chants of brahma-rākṣasas resound, Rāvaṇa awakens to auspicious music and sets out toward the aśoka grove, consumed by passion for Vaidehī.

item.title: ०१९ रावणेन सीतादर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Valmiki describes the plight of Seetha in Ashoka garden in detail.

भागसूचना
  1. रावणको देखकर दुःख, भय और चिन्तामें डूबी हुई सीताकी अवस्थाका वर्णन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Catching sight of Rāvaṇa decked in youth and finest jewels, Vaidehī trembles like a plantain tree in a storm and shields her body while sitting on the bare earth like a severed bough.

item.title: ०२० सीता-रावणसंवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Ravana entices Seetha with wealth, gems, sovereignty over all wives of Ravana.

भागसूचना
  1. रावणका सीताजीको प्रलोभन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Rāvaṇa addresses the surrounded, joyless ascetic Sītā with sweet, expressive words, defending rākṣasa abduction of others’ wives as svadharma while vowing not to touch her unwillingly.

item.title: ०२१ सीतायाः कटूत्तरम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Seetha replies to Ravana saying that He should seek friendship with Rama and return Her back to Rama.

भागसूचना
  1. सीताजीका रावणको समझाना और उसे श्रीरामके सामने नगण्य बताना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Placing a blade of grass between herself and Rāvaṇa, the weeping Sītā turns her back upon him and declares that a chaste wife can never wed another.

item.title: ०२२ रावणेन अन्तसमयसूचना
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Ravana gives Seetha two months to marry hm. He orders ogres to frighten Seetha and bring Her to his control. Ravana then goes back to his own house with his consorts.

भागसूचना
  1. रावणका सीताको दो मासकी अवधि देना, सीताका उसे फटकारना, फिर रावणका उन्हें धमकाकर राक्षसियोंके नियन्त्रणमें रखकर स्त्रियोंसहित पुनः महलको लौट जाना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Stung by Sītā’s harsh words, Rāvaṇa replies that only his overpowering passion restrains his wrath, like a skilled charioteer curbing runaway horses, from slaying her.

item.title: ०२३ राक्षसीकृतसीताभीषणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

This chapter describes the ogre women speaking to Seetha about her marrying Ravana.

भागसूचना
  1. राक्षसियोंका सीताजीको समझाना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Once Rāvaṇa departs for his inner apartments, the terrifying rākṣasīs rush upon Sītā in fury, and red-eyed Ekajaṭā extols Rāvaṇa’s descent from Prajāpati Pulastya.

विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः ।
सन्दिश्य च ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्निर्जगाम ह ॥ १ ॥

item.title: ०२४ सीता-राक्षसीसंवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Seetha cites the examples of Sachi, Arundhati, Rohini et.al., on their devotion towards their husbands. Ogre women threaten to kill Seetha and eat her.

भागसूचना
  1. सीताजीका राक्षसियोंकी बात माननेसे इनकार कर देना तथा राक्षसियोंका उन्हें मारने-काटनेकी धमकी देना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

The deformed ogresses collectively berate Sītā for spurning Rāvaṇa’s luxurious inner apartments and clinging to the exiled human Rāma, moving the lotus-eyed princess to tears.

item.title: ०२५ सीताविलापः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Seetha calls out Rama and others and bursts into a wail not being able to endure the threats of ogre women.

भागसूचना
  1. राक्षसियोंकी बात माननेसे इनकार करके शोक-संतप्त सीताका विलाप करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Weeping amid the harsh ogresses, Sītā reiterates in a choked voice that she will never wed a rākṣasa, trembling like a wolf-harassed doe as she clings to a flowering branch.

item.title: ०२६ सीतायाः प्राणत्यागनिश्चयः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Seetha ponders a lot and decides to give up life without Rama.

भागसूचना
  1. सीताका करुण-विलाप तथा अपने प्राणोंको त्याग देनेका निश्चय करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

With tear-streaked, downcast face, Sītā writhes on the ground like a filly, lamenting her abduction by shape-shifting Rāvaṇa and wondering if her unshattered heart is made of stone.

item.title: ०२७ त्रिजटास्वप्नः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter an ogress named Trijata describes her dream. She dreams of Sri Rama triumphs and the ogre Ravana is conquered.

भागसूचना
  1. त्रिजटाका स्वप्न, राक्षसोंके विनाश और श्रीरघुनाथजीकी विजयकी शुभ सूचना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Incensed by Sītā’s fierce resolve to die, the demonesses threaten to devour her flesh, whereupon the aged rākṣasī Trijaṭā awakens and rebukes them, announcing a prophetic dream.

item.title: ०२८ सीतया रावणवाक्यमननम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Seetha recollects the time limit of two months given by Ravana and her vulnerability of being killed by him. After lamenting for a while, she tries to strangle herself to death with the braid of her hair. At that moment, a propitious omen never seen before appears on her person.

भागसूचना
  1. विलाप करती हुई सीताका प्राण-त्यागके लिये उद्यत होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Trembling like a young she-elephant assailed by a lion, Sītā laments her unyielding heart and dreads that Rāvaṇa will dismember her like a surgeon dismembering a fetus.

item.title: ०२९ सीतया शुभशकुनानुभवः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Seetha experiences some good omens as follows; Her left eye, left shoulder and left thigh quivered, as also her clothing slipped a bit. Feeling these omens, her consciousness was awakened with exaltation.

भागसूचना
  1. सीताजीके शुभ शकुन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Auspicious portents wait upon sorrow-stricken Sītā like retainers upon a man favored by Fortune, as her lotus-like left eye, sandal-worthy left arm, and left thigh throb.
